name: smwmusic-mega-man-x-sting-chameleon-s-stage-remix
title: Mega Man X - Sting Chameleon's Stage (Remix)
description:
One of the most energetic themes in Mega Man history, now resampled / revised for modern romhacking!

Perfectly fits with forest stages, but athletic / sky, grass athletics, jungles, and even underground / lava stages (Super Pika Land: Chocolate Version for reference) work fine as well.

Note: In the text file, there are four customizable pitches you can adjust the song to, including versions such as the DOS / PC version, PSP Remake, and a custom version I put in there (in case anyone thinks the song sounds good on the c# minor).
